consumer: The mission/dialogue eligibility system's completion check for the fetch mission, asking 'does the player hold the required part so the turn-in to the contact can complete?'
scope: The mission's own completion-objective reach over the part the player can hand in, not merely the single actor's on-person has_charges/has_amount
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items - builds a lambda evaluating actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over only d.alpha/d.beta (one character's personal inventory)
divergence: The required part sits in adjacent vehicle cargo or a nearby container reachable for hand-in but not in the character's personal inventory: the mission-completion authority counts it satisfied while u_has_items returns false
